contract.name: Blend v2 backstop
contract.notes: Insurance layer for Blend pools. Codes 1-12 match the Stellar Asset Contract; backstop-specific codes start at 1000. Withdrawals go through a queue-for-withdrawal (Q4W) step first.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 backstop code.
fixes: Check which contract emitted the error.

errors.name: AlreadyInitializedError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 backstop code.
fixes: Check which contract emitted the error.

errors.name: UnauthorizedError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 backstop code.
fixes: Check which contract emitted the error.

errors.name: NegativeAmountError
errors.summary: A negative amount was passed to the backstop.

errors.name: BalanceError
errors.summary: Not enough backstop shares to queue or withdraw that amount.
errors.explanation: Raised when queuing more shares for withdrawal than the user holds, or when withdrawing more than their expired queue entries cover.
fixes: Queue or withdraw at most your available (or expired-queued) share amount.

errors.name: OverflowError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 backstop code.
fixes: Check which contract emitted the error.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.summary: The backstop rejected a malformed request.
errors.explanation: For example, adding a pool to the reward zone twice, or trying to remove a pool that still meets the backstop threshold.
fixes: Re-check the call arguments and current reward-zone state.

errors.name: NotExpired
errors.summary: The queued withdrawal has not finished its waiting period.
errors.explanation: Backstop withdrawals must sit in the withdrawal queue until their expiration time before they can be withdrawn.
fixes: Wait for the queue entry to expire, then call withdraw.

errors.name: InvalidRewardZoneEntry
errors.summary: This pool cannot enter the reward zone.
errors.explanation: The pool is below the backstop threshold, or it does not have more backstop deposits than the pool it would replace.
fixes: Increase the pool's backstop deposits above the threshold (and above the pool being replaced).

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.summary: The pool's backstop balance cannot cover this withdrawal or dequeue.
fixes: Withdraw or dequeue a smaller amount.

errors.name: NotPool
errors.summary: The address is not a pool deployed by the Blend pool factory.
fixes: Use the address of a pool created by the official Blend pool factory.

errors.name: InvalidShareMintAmount
errors.summary: The deposit is too small to mint any backstop shares.

errors.name: InvalidTokenWithdrawAmount
errors.summary: The withdrawal is too small to return any tokens.
fixes: Withdraw a larger number of shares.

errors.name: TooManyQ4WEntries
errors.summary: The account has too many pending withdrawal queue entries.
fixes: Wait for existing entries to expire and withdraw them, or dequeue some, before queuing more.

errors.name: NotInRewardZone
errors.summary: Declared but not raised by the v2 backstop code at the pinned commit.
fixes: Check which contract emitted the error.

errors.name: RewardZoneFull
errors.summary: The reward zone is full; a pool must be named to replace.
fixes: Pass a to_remove pool with fewer backstop deposits than the pool being added.

errors.name: MaxBackfillEmissions
errors.summary: The maximum amount of backfilled emissions has already been reached.
fixes: No user fix; backfilled emissions are capped by the protocol.

errors.name: BadDebtExists
errors.summary: The backstop still holds bad debt in this pool.
errors.explanation: The backstop has outstanding liabilities in the pool, which must be cleared (via a bad-debt auction) before this action.
fixes: Wait for the bad-debt auction to clear the backstop's liabilities.
